title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts: Praise Credit from Recent 5-Star Ratings in Conduct Disputes
content:
**Clause.** When a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts shopper disputes a conduct-complaint violation, the praise credit counts the 5-star ratings the shopper received less than one whole month before the dispute: 6 or more give a praise credit of 2 points; from 3 up to 5 (one fewer than 6) give 1 point; fewer give no credit.

The count is taken from the customer ratings on the account: each 5-star rating dated less than one whole month before the day of the dispute counts once. Ratings of 4 stars or fewer do not count, however many there are.

| 5-star ratings in the month before the dispute | Praise credit |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 2 points |
| 3, 4 or 5 | 1 point |
| 0, 1 or 2 | None |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical accounts)

- 6 five-star ratings in the month: 2 points; 5: 1 point.
- 3 five-star ratings: 1 point; 2: none.
- 4 five-star ratings in the month and 20 more from three months ago: only the 4 count — 1 point.
